comparison_with_setcc.pattern: cmp lhs, rhs; setcc al; movzb al, rax
comparison_with_setcc.critical_insight: SETcc only sets the low byte (AL). Upper bytes of RAX contain garbage. MUST use MOVZX (movzb) to zero-extend before using as 64-bit value.

movsx_rr.description: MOVSX r64, r8 - sign-extend 8-bit register to 64-bit
movsx_rr.signature: pub fn movsx_rr(&mut self, dst: Reg64, src: Reg64)
movsx_rr.use_case: Signed comparisons where result needs sign extension

1_add_movzx_method.add_method: pub fn movzx_rr(&mut self, dst: Reg64, src: Reg64) { self.rex_w(dst, src); self.emit(0x0F); self.emit(0xB6); self.modrm(0b11, dst.code(), src.code()); }
1_add_movzx_method.replace_manual_bytes: In emit_compare, replace manual byte emission with self.encoder.movzx_rr(Reg64::RAX, Reg64::RAX)
